title: When Breath Becomes Air
author: Paul Kalanithi
summary: Paul Kalanithi, a neurosurgeon, was diagnosed with metastatic lung cancer in his mid-thirties. He writes of his path to medicine, what makes a life meaningful, and turning from doctor to patient.
readIf: you want a reflective, humane memoir about mortality and what matters.
skipIf: you find stories of a young parent's terminal illness too painful right now.
